title: “Cold, Calculated, and Condescending”: How AI Identifies and Explains Ableism Compared to Disabled People

bias_targets.methodology: Curating a dataset of 200 ableist and non-ableist social media comments, prompting Toxicity Classifiers and Large Language Models (LLMs) to rate toxicity and ableism, and comparing the models' quantitative ratings and qualitative explanations against those provided by human participants, primarily people with disabilities (PwD).
